title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. On the X-Y plane, draw a two-dimensional sketch consisting of a single circle centered at coordinates [0.0052, 0.0052] with a radius of 0.0052. Scale this sketch by a factor of 0.0104 to achieve the desired dimensions. Since the Euler angles and translation vector are both set to zero, no additional transformations are required. Extrude the scaled circle along its normal direction to a depth of 0.75 units, ensuring that the extrusion does not extend in the opposite direction. This operation will result in a new solid body with a length of 0.010416666666666666 units, a width of 0.010416666666666666 units, and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the circular sketch
circle_center = (0.0052, 0.0052)
circle_radius = 0.0052
sketch = workplane.center(*circle_center).circle(circle_radius)

# Extrude the sketch to create the rod
extrude_depth = 0.75
rod = sketch.extrude(extrude_depth)

# The final model
r = rod

import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0052, 0.0052)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0052)  # Draw the circle
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# The final model
r = cylinder
